Flour4 Cups Salt2 teaspoons
Shortening ½ Cuprounded
WaterLuke-Warm 1 Cup
Beef2 Lbs.
Onion 1Large
Chili Powder½ teaspoon
Black PepperGround ¼ teaspoon
Garlic Salt1 Dash Worcestershire Sauce1 teaspoon Corn Starch1 teaspoon Green Peppers2 Red Pepper1
TomatoLarge 1
Lettuce Cheese Olives Salsa Guacamole Sour Cream
Using a fork, mix Flour, Salt, and Shortening. Add Luke-Warm Water and blend well. On a lightly-floured flat surface, knead ≈50 times. Break into 1&inch;-2&inch; balls and let sit for 15 minutes. Place Dutch Oven lid, upside down on enough charcoals to make moderately hot.
By hand, flatten each ball into a Tortilla shape. (The thinner the better.)
Cook on Dutch Oven lid until each side is slightly golden in spots. Don't break air bubbles!
Cut Beef into long thin strips. Cut Onion, Green Peppers, and Red Pepper into long thin strips. Cut Tomato into thin wedge sections. Heat Dutch Oven on a moderate amount of charcoals. With no lid, stirring occasionally, cook Beef strips until Lightly Brown. Add Onion, Chili Powder, Black Pepper, Garlic Salt, Worcestershire Sauce and Corn Starch, then stir occastionally until Beef is fully cooked. Add Green Peppers, Red Pepper and Tomato, and saut&eAcute; until Peppers are fully cooked.
If desired, you can use store-bought Tortillas.
